input-field.name: apiBase
input-field.label: MetriXs API URL
input-field.helpText: Only change this if you were given a different MetriXs URL.

input-field.name: apiKey
input-field.label: Site API key
input-field.helpText: Create one in the MetriXs dashboard: Settings → Sites → API keys.

input-field.name: trackingEnabled
input-field.label: Enable tracking
input-field.helpText: Off by default. Nothing is loaded from or sent to MetriXs until this is enabled AND the site is connected. Connecting (saving a valid API key) turns this on automatically.
